documentIds.title: Document IDs
documentIds.description: List of document IDs to be standardized, up to 100 per batch.

schemaId.title: Schema ID
schemaId.description: Unique identifier of the schema to be used for standardization - if not provided, one will be inferred.

guidelines.title: Guidelines
guidelines.description: Guidelines to apply to the schema when standardizing. If this is provided, it will override the schema guidelines.

useMetadata.title: Use Metadata
useMetadata.description: Whether to use metadata during standardization.

displayMode.title: Display Mode
displayMode.description:
*Advanced Feature*
Mode of display to run. The options are:
`auto`: AI decides how to display the document (default)
`spatial`: Display text spatially, as it appears in the document
`sections`: Display text from top to bottom as sections, with tables appearing as markdown
`image`: Display as an image, accompanied by section view

splitMode.title: Split Mode
splitMode.description:
*Advanced Feature*
Mode of splitting to run. Splitting is used to extract array fields efficiently. The options are:
`auto`: AI decides how to split the document (default)
`never`: Never split the document (this could lead to errors or poor performance for large documents)
`all`: Split the document into individual pages

effortLevel.title: Effort Level
effortLevel.description:
*Advanced Feature*
Level of effort to run. The options are:
`standard`: Standard effort level (default)
`high`: High effort level, for more difficult documents

stdVersion.title: Standardization Version
stdVersion.description: Version of the standardization job. Options: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2 (default, stable), 2.3 (experimental, higher quality but may have runtime instability).

pages.title: Target Page Ranges
pages.description:
*Advanced Feature*
For every document, list the zero indexed page numbers to standardize. If omitted, the entire document is standardized. For XLS/XLSX files, each number selects a worksheet by its zero indexed position. Page targeting is ignored for CSV, TXT, XML, and JSON files, which are always standardized in full.

transformationIds.title: Transformation IDs
transformationIds.description: Transformations to apply, in order, to each finished standardization. The result is stored as transformedData next to the original data, and each run costs 1 credit.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: The job timeout (in seconds) for webhook error reporting
